title: Rag-Coat Stake Scarecrow
description: One newly authored whole static field-scarecrow appearance: a ground stake and crossarm support an asymmetric thick rag-coat body with two drooping sleeves and genuinely jagged hem outline, two unequal hanging trouser legs, two jagged bundled-straw hand silhouettes, an anonymous sack head and a broad-brim peaked straw-hat form. Nine closed editable meshes, five opaque constant matte PBR roles. No old laundry shirt or beekeeping hat geometry is imported or extracted: all numerical body, clothes, straw and hat outlines are newly authored as one farm field fixture. Clothes and hat are closed solid game-art volumes, not hollow wearable tailoring; small fixed overlaps are explicit. Metres, Z up, whole horizontal bounds centre, stake sole at Z0. Inanimate stylised prop only, no identity of a person, rig, wind/cloth simulation, actual pest-deterrence, real installation, stability, weatherproofing or safety claim.
